'''Nik Sant''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[human]] who served in the [[Alliance Military|military]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. By the time of the [[Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY]], Sant was one of the most veteran [[scout]]s in the Rebel Alliance.

==Biography==
[[File:StrikeTeam-TPG.png|thumb|left|250px|Nik Sant was dispatched with the strike team to the Forest Moon of Endor.]]
Nik Sant served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="Episode VI" /> and by [[4 ABY]]<ref name="Date Note">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the [[Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY]]</ref> he was one of the most veteran [[scout]]s in the [[Alliance Military]].<ref name="SWFC">''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]''</ref> That year, the Rebel Alliance launched a decisive attack against the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Battle of Endor]], where they intended to destroy the Empire's [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]] [[superweapon]].<ref name="Episode VI" /> Sant, one of the [[Special Forces Trackers Unit|Pathfinders]],<ref name="Pathfinders Note">Nik Sant's unit was identified as the [[Special Forces Trackers Unit|Pathfinders]] in the comic book [[Shattered Empire 1|''Shattered Empire'' 1]]</ref> was part of a [[Endor strike team|strike team]] led by [[General]] [[Han Solo]] that was tasked with destroying the [[Death Star's shield generator|shield generator]] that powered the Death Star's shield.<ref name="Episode VI" />

Their operation was a success, allowing Alliance forces to destroy the [[orbit]]ing Death Star and fracture the Empire. Prior to the ground battle proper, he donned the armor of a captured [[scout trooper]] and took up the trooper's post at the shield generator bunker. Though the Imperials saw through his disguise and captured him, along with the rest of the strike team, he was saved when the [[Bright Tree Village|local Ewok tribe]] ambushed the Imperials, allowing Solo and the rest of the Rebels to destroy the shield generator.<ref name="Episode VI" />

==Personality and traits==
Nik Sant was, by 4 ABY,<ref name="Date Note" /> an older [[Gender|male]] [[human]] with light skin, [[Color|white]] [[hair]], and a white beard. During the Battle of Endor, he wore the typical military uniform worn by members of the Pathfinders.<ref name="Episode VI" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|…I think the one thing I have really thought about is I really do think that Rex is that guy on Endor. I really do. Why else is there a bearded old guy on Endor, Tano? Why? It makes no sense. If you don't want that to happen, do you know what that means? I'm gonna make that happen. I'm getting like Palpatine, I'm getting power crazy.|Dave Filoni on his belief that Nik Sant and Captain Rex are one and the same|<ref name="Filoni Rex Sant">{{WebCite|url=https://www.slashfilm.com/captain-rex-in-return-of-the-jedi|text=A 'Star Wars' Animated Character Might've Appeared in a Live-Action Star Wars Movie?|author=Sciretta, Peter|date=2016-03-30|work=/Film|archivedate=20200806151904}}</ref>}}
[[File:Captain_Rex_old.png|thumb|right|200px|''Star Wars Rebels'' creator and executive producer Dave Filoni has fueled speculation that Nik Sant and Captain Rex, seen above, are the same character.]]
Nik Sant appeared briefly as a member of Han Solo's strike team in the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Episode VI" /> He was first identified as Nik Sant in [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 44|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' 44]] in [[2002]],<ref name="Fact File 44">[[The Official Star Wars Fact File 44|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' 44]]</ref> being named after [[Wikipedia:Santa Claus|Saint Nicholas]].<ref name="S&V 100">{{ShipsandVehiclesCite|100|Pilots and Crew Members}}</ref> According to a continuity polaroid from ''Return of the Jedi'', he was portrayed by one "L. Burner."<ref name="Continuity Polaroids">{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwarsarchives.com/dt_gallery/1983-continuity-polaroids|text=Return of the Jedi continuity polaroids|work=Star Wars Archives|archivedate=20180314171407}}</ref>

The similarities between Sant's appearance and that of the former [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex]], a character who appears in both the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' and ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' television series, stoked speculation that Sant and Rex could be the same character. In [[2016]], at a screening of the [[Twilight of the Apprentice|second season finale]] of ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'', executive producer [[Dave Filoni]] speculated that the "bearded old guy on Endor," Nik Sant, could be Rex, suggesting it did not make any sense for there to be an "old guy" on Endor unless it was someone like Rex.<ref name="Filoni Rex Sant" /> The ''Rebels'' series finale, which aired on [[March 5]], [[2018]], confirmed that Rex did fight at the Battle of Endor, but did not go so far as to confirm that Rex and Sant are the same character.<ref name="Family Reunion – and Farewell">{{Rebels|Family Reunion – and Farewell}}</ref> Six months after the episode's airing, Filoni revealed in an interview with [[Wikipedia:IGN|''IGN'']] he ultimately chose to not officially canonize the theory, stating that he did not want to take a character that had existed prior to him joining ''Star Wars'', and didn't want to lay it down in stone one way or the other, adding that Rex could have been present at Endor and not be Sant. Because of this deliberate ambiguity, he stated some fans could choose to believe that Sant and Rex are the same individual while others choose to not do so.<ref name="Rex=Sant? Nay Nay!">{{WebCite|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/2018/08/12/star-wars-rebels-season-4-finale-clone-wars-final-season-revival-disney-dave-filoni|text=Star Wars Rebels Creator Dave Filoni Reveals How Season 4 Almost Ended and His Clone Wars Revival Plans|author=Huver, Scott|date=2018-08-12|archivedate=20200524074632}}</ref>

In recreations of shots from ''Return of the Jedi'' in the ''[[Star Wars Galaxy of Adventures]]'' short "[[Han Solo - From Smuggler to General]]," Rex is used instead of Sant wearing [[clone trooper armor]]. Rex also appears in original shots in the short.<ref name="Smuggler to General">{{GOA|Han Solo - From Smuggler to General}}</ref> Because ''Galaxy of Adventures'' shorts are not meant to be taken as literal events,<ref name="GoA tweet">{{Twitter|missingwords|status/1139593657986588675|[[Matt Martin]]|quote=I think it's just the usual GoA stuff, not meant to be taken literally.|archivefile=File:MattMartinGoA.jpg}}</ref> no official source has currently definitively stated that Sant and Rex are the same character.
